searchText: we still have a bunch of open prs for the builder spec can we aim to merge them/close them? https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/165 https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/162 https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/144 - 144 should be covered by 165 + the keymanager api 88 (probably can be closed) - 165 is what was discussed in the breakout room yesterday, it's what clients should build towards and Nico said merge only after implementation/more feedback - I believe the decision on 162 has been punted. I remember Bharath saying it should be revisited after clients implemented and decided if it was worth the complexity. worth discussing (i used to be in favor of it, now I'm not)

excerpts.content:
- 144 should be covered by 165 + the keymanager api 88 (probably can be closed)
- 165 is what was discussed in the breakout room yesterday, it's what clients should build towards and Nico said merge only after implementation/more feedback
- I believe the decision on 162 has been punted. I remember Bharath saying it should be revisited after clients implemented and decided if it was worth the complexity. worth discussing (i used to be in favor of it, now I'm not)
